vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: slogan-maker
Version: 1.0.1

The slogan-maker skill is a legitimate utility for generating marketing taglines and brand slogans. Analysis of 'scripts/slogan.sh' and 'SKILL.md' shows the code relies entirely on static templates and basic string length heuristics to provide suggestions, with no evidence of network activity, file system modifications, or malicious prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with a local/offline slogan generator: it contains a self-contained bash script and documentation, asks for no credentials, and makes no external calls.

dimensions.detail: The name and description (slogan generation, translation, testing, collection) match the included files. The included scripts implement those features locally in bash. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md refers to a `slogan-maker` command while the shipped runnable is scripts/slogan.sh (`slogan.sh` in examples); this is a packaging/naming mismatch but not a security concern.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the script limit behavior to reading user arguments, generating templates, heuristics, and static collections. There are no instructions to read unrelated files, environment variables, or system configuration, nor to send data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only), and the single script is plain bash. Nothing is downloaded or extracted during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script does not reference secrets or network credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills or system-wide settings, and can run only when invoked by the user or agent per platform defaults.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a simple, offline slogan generator implemented in a bash script and is coherent with its description. If you plan to install it: (1) verify how the script will be invoked on your system (SKILL.md mentions `slogan-maker` but the shipped script is `slogan.sh`), (2) review the script (already done here) or run it in a sandbox if you want extra assurance, and (3) note that the repository includes contact/website strings (bytesagain.com, hello@bytesagain.com) but the code performs no network operations or credential use. If you need the skill integrated as a system-level command, ensure the packaging step that installs/renames the script is trustworthy.
